command:
mkdir -p agent/hosted-proof
cd agent
python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-test-venv"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-test-venv/bin/python" -m pip install -e '.[dev]' > hosted-proof/setup.log 2>&1
"$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-test-venv/bin/python" scripts/ci_install_runtime.py >> hosted-proof/setup.log 2>&1
set +e
"$RUNNER_TEMP/agent-test-venv/bin/python" -m pytest -s -v tests/packs/h3_av/test_character_swap_cpu_boundary.py::test_cpu_host_readiness_identity_reaches_real_installed_guard > hosted-proof/selector.log 2>&1
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" > hosted-proof/selector.exit
exit "$rc"
